mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals labor market weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns as economic growth falters.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the 20-day periods after UNRATE exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment and decrease in payroll employment indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 60-day periods following labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates during a monetary tightening cycle may lead to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 60-day periods following a 5% increase in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: Slow growth in industrial production may indicate supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 60-day periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 50% of the 5-day periods following PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A high Consumer Price Index may lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.
